purpose: Research and normalization rules for housing factors. This is data policy, not UI configuration.
global_rules: Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never FALSE.
A broader-scope claim cannot prove a narrower-scope factor: building evidence does not prove a unit or bedroom feature.
A price labeled per person does not prove an individual lease.
A bed/bath count does not prove that a bathroom is assigned exclusively to one bedroom.
Select units, subject to availability, waitlist, or optional add-on language must remain conditional.
Route factors must preserve the selected travel mode and reference time; never silently substitute modes.
Accessibility factors require confirmation for the exact unit and complete path, not a generic accessibility badge.
source_priority: Executed lease or dated written offer
Official transit, campus, or municipal data
Resident report used only as context, never as sole proof of a contractual or exact-unit fact

calculated.missing_data: Keep UNKNOWN when the required route, destination, schedule, or selected mode is unavailable.

listed.missing_data: Require an explicit current listing, inventory, or offer statement; omission is UNKNOWN.

floor_plan_or_exact_unit.missing_data: Require the assigned floor plan, room dimensions, or exact-unit statement; do not infer from photos.

policy_or_lease.missing_data: Require the current written offer, lease, fee schedule, or building policy; unresolved conditions stay pending.

manual_exact_unit_confirmation.missing_data: Obtain written confirmation for the assigned unit and the complete relevant route.
